name: ariga
description: Agent skills for Atlas, the database schema-as-code tool.

plugins.name: atlas
plugins.description: Atlas skills for coding agents: database schema management with the Atlas CLI, guided onboarding of a project onto Atlas, the CI/CD steps of the Atlas actions, the Atlas Kubernetes Operator, and the specifics of each database: PostgreSQL, MySQL and MariaDB, SQL Server and Azure SQL, ClickHouse, Snowflake, Databricks, Databricks Lakebase, Redshift, Oracle Database, and Google Cloud Spanner.
